queries.query: LLMs OR "large language model" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network change" OR "network repair") AND (failure OR error OR misconfiguration OR hallucinat* OR incorrect*)
queries.rationale: Map the phenomenon: documented failure modes where LLM outputs cause incorrect or unsafe network actions (misconfigurations, hallucinations, incorrect plans).

queries.query: "intent-to-configuration" OR "natural language to configuration" OR "intent driven network configuration" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Survey work that translates operator intent (NL) to device/configuration artifacts to understand typical pipelines and points of brittleness.
source_preferences: technical reports / datasheets (vendor docs for format examples)

queries.query: (generate AND validate AND repair) AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR agent)
queries.rationale: Find architectures that combine generation, automated validators, and repair loops (G-V-R) used to improve NetOps reliability.

queries.query: network configuration verification OR "network verification" OR "formal verification" AND (SMT OR model checking OR "static analysis") AND (config OR policy)
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic/verifier mechanisms in networking (e.g., header space analysis, VeriFlow, Batfish) that can serve as validators or ground-truth oracles.

queries.query: bounded self-correction OR "LLM self-correction" OR "tool assisted correction" AND (network OR config OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Investigate mechanisms for limiting or bounding iterative LLM corrections to avoid cascades of erroneous changes in operational workflows.

queries.query: AIOps OR "AI for IT operations" OR "LLM for AIOps" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operations") AND (benchmark OR dataset OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Identify benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation practices in AIOps/NetOps to assess current validity and gaps for operational reliability studies.

queries.query: benchmarks OR evaluation AND ("LLM" OR "foundation model") AND networking AND (limitations OR validity OR reproducibility OR "threats to validity")
queries.rationale: Gather critical analyses of benchmark validity, dataset representativeness, synthetic vs. real configs, and reproducibility concerns relevant to NetOps tasks.

queries.query: agentic OR autonomous agent OR "tool-using agent" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operator") AND (safety OR guardrails OR constraints OR "tool orchestration")
queries.rationale: Survey agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks (tool use, action verification, constrained agents) that could manage NetOps tasks.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop OR "operator trust" OR "human oversight" AND (LLM OR agent OR "autonomous NetOps") AND (usability OR acceptance OR error recovery)
queries.rationale: Capture human factors: operator trust, oversight policies, and mixed-initiative workflows impacting safety and deployment viability.

queries.query: datasets AND ("network configuration" OR "NetOps" OR "routing policies" OR "SDN policies") AND (public OR benchmark OR corpus)
queries.rationale: Locate publicly available datasets and corpora suitable for reproducible experimentation and validation of NetOps LLM workflows.

queries.query: case study OR "failure analysis" AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration change") AND (automation OR script OR agent)
queries.rationale: Find empirical case studies of automation-caused incidents or failure analyses to ground threat models and real-world mitigations.

queries.query: related-work: "program synthesis" OR "code generation" AND (configuration OR network) AND (evaluation OR correctness OR verification)
queries.rationale: Adjacent literature on program synthesis and code-generation correctness informs methods for spec-to-code translation, validators, and repair in NetOps.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints with clear methods/results, released technical reports) that directly address LLM/agent use for network configuration, change planning, or NetOps automation.
Work presenting validators, formal verification, or deterministic analyzers for network configurations (e.g., Batfish, VeriFlow, HSA) that can serve as oracles or comparators.
Papers describing generate-validate-repair architectures, tool-assisted LLM correction, constrained/guarded generation, or agent orchestration applicable to NetOps.
Datasets, benchmarks, and reproducible artifact releases (code/data) for network configs, routing policies, or AIOps tasks.
Empirical failure analyses, postmortems, or case studies describing automation-caused network incidents with technical detail.
Human-factors and HCI studies addressing operator trust, oversight, and mixed-initiative workflows in network management.
Works up to the current date (include 2015–2026 for background; prioritize 2018+) with preference for the most recent advances (2020–2026) given LLM rapid progress.
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing or high-level blog posts without verifiable technical detail or primary artifacts (unless used only to locate primary technical documents).
Papers that discuss language-model architectures in isolation without any networking/NetOps application or toolchain relevance.
Works solely about unrelated infrastructure domains (e.g., database tuning) unless methods are directly adaptable and explicitly discussed.
Non-English publications unless an English translation or summary with verifiable details exists.
Very old networking work (pre-2010) unless foundational (formal verification methods) and cited for historical grounding.
date_rationale: Include literature from roughly 2015 to the present, prioritizing 2018–2026. Rationale: foundational network-verification and NetOps automation literature predates LLMs (hence include earlier key verifier work), while the LLM and agentic-AIOps surge—and most relevant mitigation and benchmarking papers—appear from ~2018 onward; the search must cover up-to-date (through 2026) preprints and conference proceedings to capture the latest agentic and LLM-for-NetOps work.
